name: Daria
quote:
What I love about working at Hello Robo is the people and the feeling of being part of a team. We share ideas, learn from each other, and everyone brings something different to the table. You don’t have to have all the answers or a perfectly formed idea to speak up. You can just share what’s on your mind, and sometimes that’s how the best things start.
I also really like that we get along so well as people, not just as colleagues. It makes working together feel easy and fun. And personally, I think Hello Robo is the best place I could work at because we can always talk about things and find a solution that works for everyone. I feel like there’s room to be myself, and that means a lot to me.
